name: Dragon's Rage
text: Keywords: Slow. An ally kicks an enemy into the enemy Nexus, striking the enemy then the enemy Nexus. If the enemy survives, Recall it.

name: Eggnivia
text: Level up: Round Start: If you're Enlightened, transform me back into Anivia and Level Up.

name: Evelynn
text: Origin: Agony's Embrace. When I'm summoned, summon a random Husk. Level up: When I see you or an ally kill an allied Husk, give me its positive keywords this round and I level up.

name: First Wave
text: When I'm summoned, summon a Prey.

name: Flow
text: Keywords: Fleeting, Burst. Heal an ally or your Nexus 2, and create an Ebb and Flow in hand.

name: Fury of the North
text: Keywords: Burst. Give an ally +3|+4 this round.

name: Last Wind
text: To play me, kill an ally.

name: Mark of the Storm
text: Keywords: Fast, Fleeting. Grant an enemy Mark of the Storm. If they already have it, remove the mark to Stun and deal 2 to them instead.

name: Packmother Nidalee
text: Keywords: Overwhelm, Quick Attack. Ambush 2 Nexus Strike: Transform me back into Nidalee and create a Javelin Toss in hand.

name: Prank
text: Keywords: Focus. Pick 1 of 2 non-champion cards from the enemy hand or deck and Prank it.

name: Sharpened Resolve
text: Keywords: Burst. Give an ally +3|+2 this round.

name: Chime
text: Keywords: Boon. Grant a random ally in hand +1|+1.
